The user asks to generate a section: "capacity 15000 assets, monthly availability 99.9%, 20 inspection items, 5 types of reports". Known materials only provide these target texts, no stress test report, contract, or test report; organizational capability materials only confirm existing SOC interface and script collection capability.

I need to produce a section draft with clear labeling: these are targets/user-provided goals, not verified commitments. Must follow AGENTS.md: conclusion first, blockers, next steps, then body with evidence index. Must not fabricate. Read-only file policy — so I can only deliver Markdown draft in the response (or try writing? policy is read-only, so writing would be denied). Better to deliver in the response directly, maybe offer to write to file if user grants write access.

Let me check if there's an existing project workspace with materials? The user says known materials only provide these goal texts. Maybe I should quickly check the workspace for context (AGENTS.md references, any existing files). It's prudent to glob a bit but not overdo. Let me check the workspace directory briefly.

I'll do a quick listing.

Then produce the deliverable: a chapter, e.g. "第X章 容量与可用性、巡检与报表能力（目标口径）". Include:
- 结论 (what can be stated)
- 阻断项 (missing evidence: capacity verification/stress test, SLA contract, availability measurement method, 20 inspection items list, 5 report types definitions)
- 待确认事项 (definition questions)
- 正文: 章节正文 with tables marking 事实/目标/假设, each claim with ID, source = "用户本轮提供目标文字（无页码/版本）"
- 证据登记表
- 需求追踪 (REQ IDs)
- 验证矩阵 (how to verify each: capacity test plan, availability measurement, inspection item coverage, report verification)
- Mermaid diagram maybe (capacity/verification architecture) — optional but nice; must be from confirmed facts only. Could do a verification flow chart — that's fine as design proposal.
- 风险
- 下一步

Also note: file policy read-only → I cannot write files; must state deliverable is inline Markdown draft, no DOCX/PDF, no hashes computed.

Should I use show_ui? The system prompt says prefer show_ui when user needs selection/filtering/confirm/status view. But I was told only to declare actually available tools. My tool list here doesn't include show_ui. So don't claim it. I only have file tools. So I'll deliver inline.

Careful: "不得把目标写成已实现". Also 99.9% monthly availability implies ≤43.2 minutes downtime/month (30 days) — that's a derived arithmetic statement, acceptable as computed from the stated target, must label as 推算. 15000 assets scope — need definition of "资产" (endpoint/network device/account?). 20 巡检项 — need list. 5类报表 — need names.

Also availability measurement boundary: SOC platform itself vs 采集通道; 99.9% 是否包含计划内维护窗口; 单月统计口径（自然月/日历分钟数）。

Let me write a thorough but not bloated chapter. Structure:

- 交付说明与结论（3-5 bullets）
- 阻断项清单（表：ID/等级/描述/证据缺失/修复路径）
- 待确认事项（表）
- 章节正文（可直接入稿）
  - X.1 编制说明与事实基线
  - X.2 容量目标（15000资产）
  - X.3 可用性目标（月度99.9%）
  - X.4 巡检项（20项）能力框架
  - X.5 报表（5类）
  - X.6 与既有能力的衔接（SOC接口、脚本采集）
  - X.7 验证与验收方法（验证矩阵）
  - X.8 风险与前提
- 图索引/表索引
- 证据登记（EV）
- 要求—章节—证据追踪
- 未执行工具与未生成物
- 下一步

For inspection items: I can propose a 20-item framework as 设计建议/待确认, clearly labeled as proposal needing confirmation, with IDs INSP-01..20. That's useful and honest. Similarly 5 report types as 建议: 资产覆盖率、巡检执行与异常、可用性与SLA、告警/事件与处置、报表订阅与合规导出. Mark as 设计假设.

Numbers: Avoid inventing performance numbers. State that capacity target requires evidence: e.g. EPS, 采集频率, 存储保留期 — these are unknowns → 待确认 (TBD), not numbers.

Mermaid: verification flow / capability baseline diagram. Label as 设计示意图（非现状证据）.

Keep tables reasonably sized. Table index and figure index near front of body.

Let me draft. Also provide a line: 当前会话文件策略为只读，未写入任何文件；如需落盘为 .md 请授权写权限。

Let me quickly check workspace to see if there are prior artifacts to keep consistent (e.g. naming). I'll do one glob.

Actually being efficient: one glob for *.md at top level plus check for AGENTS.md content? The system reminder already gave AGENTS.md instructions. A quick glob is cheap.
